title: 사마리탄
ctx: Film 「Samaritan」(2022, Amazon/MGM, director Julius Avery). Sylvester Stallone as Joe Smith, a reclusive garbage man who is secretly Samaritan, a superhero believed dead for 25 years after a fight with his twin brother Nemesis; Javon Walton as Sam Cleary, a 13-year-old boy in Granite City who believes Samaritan is alive; Dascha Polanco as Tiffany, Sam's mother; Pilou Asbæk as Cyrus, a gang leader who takes up Nemesis's hammer to start a riot; Moisés Arias as Reza, a young gang member; Sophia Tatum as Sil. Twist: Joe is actually Nemesis, who survived and took his brother's place.
